The library opens a folder onto the canvases in it and the folders inside it.

- A folder starts collapsed. Its name ends with a slash, and the count is the canvases and child folders directly inside it.
- Opening it shows those canvases, then the child folders. A child is named for itself (`coffee-pos/`), not the full path.
- Open, Code, and Copy link stay on each canvas. Folders and Knowledge stay.
